  "rationale": "The added columns richly enumerate candidate causes (topic mention counts and a complaint category), so a treatment is clearly present. The only column that even weakly plays this role is review_length_bucket (longer text yields more mentions and may relate to sentiment intensity); it is a mechanical proxy rather than a substantive confounder. No genuine common cause external to the text (e.g., reviewer disposition, restaurant type, visit occasion, rating baseline) was surfaced. negative_signal_count is essentially a restatement of the outcome/mediator, not a confounder. Thus the design is a factor-enumeration/correlational setup, not a properly confounder-adjusted causal estimation, and confounder quality is low."
